text:
marcus: Heads-up — I'm putting together a Route Insights dashboard for the Console that breaks down token-level latency by causal slices. Goal: make per-route perf regressions and optimization opportunities obvious. :bar_chart:

anita: Nice. Which slices are you thinking? keep it high-signal so we don't explode metrics costs.

marcus: Current draft slices: KV cache hit, KV cache miss (fetch), kernel selection time (kernel lookup + launch), batch queue time, decode time. Plus p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, and error rate.

kai: Agree on cost concern. Proposal: only compute full token-slice histogram for routes with >20 qps sustained or for sampled traces (1%) otherwise show aggregate p50/p95/p99.

sophia: For kernel selection, can we tag the backend with kernel_id and variant (fp16, int8, q4h) so the Console can group by that? Would help show when an auto-quant rollout changed tail latency.

marcus: Yes — runtime can emit kernel_id and kernel_variant as labels. But those increase cardinality. We should limit to top N kernels per route and collapse the rest into "other".

anita: Agreed. Also: show KV hit ratio as a simple % over the window alongside the token-slices. Quick eyeball for whether cache is helping.

deploy-bot: alert: p99 spike observed on /api/generate at 2026-02-05T09:14:02Z — profiling link: https://prof.redwood/trace/abc123 (KV miss rate up 4x)

marcus: Good example. Dashboard should link to trace/profiler for that route/time window. Also add a "compare" mode: compare route v1 vs v2 (rollout) for the same window.

kai: One implementation note: token-level breakdown requires per-token timing events emitted from the runtime, e.g.

```
{route: "/api/generate", token_idx: 42, stage: "kv_fetch", ms: 0.8}
{route: "/api/generate", token_idx: 42, stage: "kernel_exec", ms: 12.4, kernel_id: "gemm_v2", variant: "int8"}
```

kai: We should aggregate at ingestion to histograms; don't keep per-token raw events.

anita: Also add retention tiers: 7d detailed histograms, 90d compact pXX only. Keeps storage sane.

sophia: UX request: in the route row, show a tiny sparkline of p95 and a small stacked bar for token-slice percentages (KV hit, kernel, decode). Click to expand full breakdown.

marcus: UX + instrumentation decision: default view shows p50/p95/p99 and throughput. Expanding swaps in the token waterfall with stacked bars and per-kernel filter.

kai: For cost-sensitive routes, offer "sampled waterfall" where we compute exact slices on 1% of requests and extrapolate. Flag sampling in the UI.

anita: Metrics queries I sketched for the ingested histograms:

```
# p95 tokens per route
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket{route="/api/generate"}[5m])) by (le))

# kv hit ratio
sum(rate(token_stage_count{route="/api/generate",stage="kv_hit"}[5m])) /
(sum(rate(token_stage_count{route="/api/generate"}[5m])))
```

anita: We'll need dashboards to color-code regressions (p95 +20% baseline) and surface root-cause suggestions (e.g., KV miss spike -> recommend increasing prefix cache).

marcus: Action items:
- marcus: wire Console mockup and example panel definitions for design review (ETA 2d)
- anita: finalize ingestion schema and retention tiers (ETA 4d)
- kai: add kernel_id + variant labels and top-N collapse in runtime (ETA 1w)
- sophia: mock UX expanded view and exportable CSV for A/B comparisons (ETA 3d)

sophia: One more ask: include per-route recent rollout metadata (model version, quant profile) in the panel header so SREs can quickly correlate.

marcus: Yup, will include rollout badges and a little "compare to previous" toggle.

kai: We'll prototype sampling + top-N kernel collapse in staging. I'll post a link to the test dashboard once I have metrics flowing.

anita: Flag: need to coordinate with finance on cost estimate for enabling histograms company-wide. I'll pull numbers after schema is finalized.

marcus: Cool. If no major objections I'll schedule a 30m sync Friday to walk the mock and instrumentation plan. :thumbsup:

sophia: +1

kai: +1

anita: +1

marcus: meeting scheduled -> https://calendar.redwood/meet/route-insights-review 2026-02-07 11:00 PST
